findings.title: Unprotected mutating Django view function: rctool_import
findings.impact: View executes database mutations without enforcing user authentication or permission checks, exposing endpoints to unauthenticated callers.
findings.recommendation: Decorate the view with `@login_required` or apply DRF permission classes requiring authentication.
